_comment: CHAR.8 production run on ArtSource/Dragons/images (16 real GLBs, commit 0561a42). limbCount "auto" = rig only when the mesh measurement is unambiguous (2 or 4 feet, high confidence), otherwise refused with the measurement in the report. These are NOT GDD values: replace with the art director's number once confirmed. emberling, sprout, amberhorn state "bốn chân" in canonical data; frostfin and leviathan have no walking limbs. files.03_sprout.yawOffset 90: the source GLB faces -X (measured in the CHAR.8 front render); +90° about +Z turns it to the pipeline's -Y front. Not a biology change. species.emberling.repair (CHAR.9b): chibi skin/motion repair measured on the real Emberling GLB (anim_qa PASS, 0 warnings); other species get it only after their own QA run.
